Chapter 324: Chapter 19: Innumerable Arrogant Figures Of The World, Who Dares To Stand Side By Side With You (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 324: Chapter 19: Innumerable Arrogant Figures of the World, Who Dares to Stand Side by Side with You (Seeking Subscriptions)

“Seventh-Rank Peak, no, this speed has already reached the Eighth Layer threshold.”

The Unicorn Man judged in his heart.

“It must be some Seventh-Rank Peak Evolver who specializes in speed…”

The Unicorn Man gazed in the direction Lin Yuan had fled, “Impressive, he actually deceived me.”

If Lin Yuan had shown this kind of power or speed from the beginning,

The Unicorn Man would have immediately ordered the Heiyuan Clan’s strong ones to block him ahead of time.

...

But Lin Yuan did not.

Instead, he disguised himself as an ordinary Sixth Rank Evolver.

This might sound simple, but it’s difficult to execute.

The most crucial point was to deceive the Unicorn Man’s perception.

When Suspended Mountain ascended and countless Evolvers fled,

The Unicorn Man quickly identified many Seventh Rank Evolvers’ locations.

However, Lin Yuan’s Yin God was a Primordial Spirit Body.

Lacking a physical form, his aura and the Power of Taiyin nearly merged together,

Even someone as powerful as the Unicorn Man could commonly overlook him with a cursory sensing.

“It’s too late.”

The Unicorn Man saw Lin Yuan had already left the range of the Battlefields of Different Races,

And knew that even if he personally gave chase, he might not succeed.

After leaving the range of the Battlefields of Different Races, Human Race Evolvers can control cosmic spaceships and perform Wormhole Shuttle.

“Damn it.”

“You actually killed Feiyu.”

The stocky man, Xueyou, furiously stared in the direction of Lin Yuan’s escape, intending to pursue.

“No need to chase.”

At that moment, the voice of the Unicorn Man rang in Xueyou’s ears.

“Continue to surround and kill the other Human Seventh Rank Evolvers.”

The Unicorn Man instructed.

Letting Lin Yuan, a Seventh-Rank Peak Evolver, escape was indeed regrettable.

But there are still many Human Seventh Rank Evolvers who haven’t escaped yet,

They are the next primary targets of the Heiyuan Clan.

“Yes.”

Xueyou took a deep breath and returned to his position.

…

“Did I actually escape too?”

The Armored Man followed in the direction Lin Yuan had fled and unexpectedly escaped the Battlefields of Different Races without obstructions.

“It’s the Yuanyin brothers…”

The Armored Man immediately realized why his escape was so smooth.

Considering the circumstances just now, as a Sixth Rank Evolver like him, he should have received significant attention from the Heiyuan Different Species.

At least one Seventh Rank Evolver should have been dispatched to stop him.

But Lin Yuan, with a shockingly powerful technique, had severely killed a Seventh-Rank member of the Heiyuan Clan, resulting in a gap in that area’s blockade.

That surprisingly allowed him such an easy escape.

“The strength of the Yuanyin brothers must be really strong, perhaps nearing a commander level…”

The Armored Man, grateful for his fortune, then thought back to the scene of Lin Yuan killing that Seventh Rank Different Species.

So swift and decisive, the opponent didn’t even have time to react, it was unbelievable.

That Seventh Rank Different Species probably possessed Marquis-Level strength,

With such strength, aside from a Seventh Rank King, who could kill so effortlessly?

“Just a moment ago, I thought of having the Yuanyin brother follow me for protection?”

The Armored Man felt somewhat embarrassed with Lin Yuan’s previously displayed strength,

It’s likely that instead of him protecting Lin Yuan, he would have been dragging Lin Yuan down.

When Lin Yuan first arrived at the Battlefields of Different Races, it was he who came forward to welcome him.

The Armored Man had then invited Lin Yuan to go to the central battlefield to kill Different Species together, but he was refused. He had thought Lin Yuan was weak or not good at fighting.

Now it seems he was completely wrong.

“Quickly proceed with Wormhole Shuttle.”

The Armored Man immediately took out a cosmic spaceship from his storage ring,

Then activated Wormhole Shuttle, and like flowing water, soon disappeared out of sight.

…

Sixty light-years from the Battlefields of Different Races.

The force of space subtly started to fluctuate.

A dark spaceship appeared.

Lin Yuan was piloting the spaceship, continuously heading towards the territory of the Human Civilization.

Wormhole Shuttle has a cooldown period under normal circumstances and cannot be continually used.

“With my current combat power, under a sneak attack, I have the possibility of killing a Seventh-Rank Marquis…”

Lin Yuan began to reassess everything that had just happened.

That Seventh Rank Different Species was probably equivalent to a Human Seventh-Rank Marquis,

Normally, facing Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit, even if defeated, should have been able to struggle for a while.

But the opponent underestimated Lin Yuan too much.

Leading to an instant kill.

One must know, this was only Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

After stepping into the Seventh Rank, due to the creation of an Inner World, the strength of Lin Yuan’s main body had increased the most.

As for the two Primordial Spirits, they were much weaker.

Even so, they could still sweep through ordinary Seventh Rank Marquis levels.

If it were the main body’s turn, even a Seventh Rank King would have to be suppressed.

After all, among the Seventh Rank Evolvers, the power of the World essentially amounts to cheating.

“Continue the shuttle.”

Soon, the Wormhole Shuttle’s cooldown period ended.

Lin Yuan did not hesitate to start another round of shuttle.

A day or two later.

Lin Yuan officially entered the territory of Human Civilization.

Only at this moment did Lin Yuan finally breathe a slight sigh of relief.

The Black Abyss Clan, no matter how crazy, wouldn’t dare to pursue into the territory of Human Civilization.

Even the Insect Race wouldn’t dare enter the territory of Human Civilization unless absolutely necessary because that would mean escalating the war.

Whether it’s Human Civilization or other Peak Clans of the Cosmic Starry Sky, the reason for establishing the Battlefields of Different Races

Is to try to keep the war confined to those battlefields.

If there were no constraints, everyone invading each other’s territories would lead to much greater losses.

“Hurry up and go back.”

Lin Yuan waited for the cooldown to end and then initiated another Wormhole Shuttle.

…

Battlefields of Different Races.

The fighting gradually calmed down.

The Unicorn Man’s gaze was icy, with the stocky man, Xueyou, reporting next to him.

“Lord, during this blockade and killing operation, we killed thirty-six Human Seventh Rank Evolvers, five hundred seventy-two Sixth Rank Evolvers, and two thousand eight hundred thirty-seven Fifth and Fourth Rank Evolvers…”
